body_html: Tonight was a great night to kick off” The Sunday night Grid Iron Challenge at The Platte River Bar & Grill! Bryan from Jammin’ DJs teamed up with David from the Platte to create a unique experience combining Trivia, Bingo, and Football into one GIANT Sunday night party! With plenty of prizes given out and great drink specials all night, not to mention a Bag Toss game during halftime, people will definitely be coming back every Sunday night for THE GRIDIRON CHALLENGE!
